claims.quote: The polymorphism rs211037 of the GABRG2 gene increases the risk of the development of idiopathic generalized epilepsy in the Macedonian population.
Carriers of CC genotype had approximately a 2-fold higher probability of developing IGE than the carriers of CT and TT genotypes.
Carriers of the C allele had a 1.9-folds higher probability for IGE than the carriers of the T allele.
